OWNER DECISION — SIMPLIFY (round 4). Three review rounds kept finding edge cases in killing whole process TREES (descendant traversal, re-enrolled children, rejected intermediate nodes, T3 browser descendants). We drop tree killing entirely:
A. A signal may go ONLY to a process that ITSELF classifies as an allowed victim kind at the moment of sending: chrome BROWSER ROOT (chrome-family exe, no --type= token, chrome-sandbox/crashpad excluded), godot, DuckPit player (DuckPit*/ *.x86_64 under /duckpit/build/), unity_editor (exe under /tools/unity/editors/). Never signal descendants, helpers, renderers, sleep, shells, anything else. No traversal at all. SIGTERM, then after 5 s SIGKILL the SAME process only (re-validated). Chrome kills its own renderers on SIGTERM; Godot/DuckPit have no relevant children; Unity editor helpers left behind are an accepted residual.
B. T3 browser exclusion: a chrome process is excluded if its exe/realpath/args contain /.t3/ OR any process in its LIVE ancestor chain (walk ppid up to pid 1 via /proc/PID/stat, max 64 steps) is the T3 server (cmdline contains 't3' and 'serve') or has exe under ~/.t3/. Unreadable ancestor => excluded (fail closed).
C. Orphan (R5) = the browser root's ppid read directly from /proc/PID/stat equals 1. Nothing else counts as orphan (not "parent missing from procs"). Unreadable => not orphan.
D. R2 metric: unreclaimable = anon + shmem + kernel_stack + pagetables + sock + slab_unreclaimable (+ file_dirty + file_writeback, conservative) from T3CG memory.stat; any missing field => R2 unknown (silent), EXCEPT memory.events oom_kill increase since the previous sample => R2 critical. Drop memory.events 'max' as a trigger (it grows on harmless cache fill). Delete calc_reclaim.
E. Executor queue: any detection of dry/off anywhere (submit, tick, send, check) clears the WHOLE pending queue immediately; KILL is sent only if the live dry/off files are absent at that very moment.
F. Keep everything else that already passed review: pidfd-only signalling (no os.kill fallback), per-signal re-validation (starttime, uid, cgroup membership, exe/kind unchanged, fingerprint re-read right before pidfd_send_signal), never/protected lists, cgroup discovery from cron, R1 cap 3 kills/10 min, one R1–R3 kill per pass, cooldown recorded only after a real action, R6 notify-only with honest gap handling, notifications only after a real signal, off/dry switches, --once/--status/--dry-run/--selftest.
Round-3 blocking findings this must eliminate: (1) t3 serve -> system Chrome -> renderer: renderer enrolled as its own job and got TERM; (2) recipient path not verified, rejected parent did not cut off the new child; known grandchild used as traversal start; (3) calc_reclaim wrong both ways; (4) parent missing from procs treated as outside cgroup -> live Chrome chosen by R5; (5) dry/off detected in submit() did not clear the queue -> later KILL.
Remove the dead code (job trees, traversal, calc_reclaim) instead of leaving it unused. Update selftest: delete tests of removed behaviour, add tests reproducing each round-3 finding (they must fail on the round-3 behaviour) and tests that a descendant/renderer/sleep is NEVER signalled. Update the .md (what is killed now, residuals).
